definitions.gloss: competence; capability; reliability; ability to provide
definitions.explanation: The quality of being capable and reliable, especially in earning a living and supporting a family. Traditionally used to evaluate men as providers, though the concept is broadening in modern usage.

examples.japanese: {甲斐性|かいしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧。
{甲斐性|かいしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: I was told I have no gumption.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「{甲斐性|かいしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧な」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{言|い}っていた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother often said, "Whatever you do, don't marry a man with no gumption."

notes:
Also written {甲斐性|かいしょ} (shorter reading). Derives from ⟦{甲斐|かい}→甲斐：15851_kai⟧ (worth, effect) + ⟦{性|しょう}→〜性：28334_shou⟧ (nature, character).

USAGE:
{甲斐性|かいしょう} is a somewhat old-fashioned word that evaluates a person's practical competence — their ability to earn money, manage a household, and be a dependable provider. It appears most often in the negative: {甲斐性|かいしょう}なし or {甲斐性|かいしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (lacking competence, unreliable). While traditionally applied to men as breadwinners, it can be used for anyone's ability to get things done and be self-sufficient.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {甲斐性|かいしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to be capable, dependable
- {甲斐性|かいしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to be incompetent, unreliable
- {甲斐性|かいしょう}なし: a good-for-nothing
- {甲斐性|かいしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a capable, reliable person

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{器量|きりょう}→器量：25479_kiryou⟧: ability, caliber — a person's capacity and character; in older usage, also means facial attractiveness
- ⟦{頼|たの}もしい→頼もしい：07899_tanomoshii⟧: dependable, reassuring — an adjective describing someone you can count on
- ⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧: ability, capability — a neutral, modern term for skills and abilities without the traditional provider connotation
